From the table

Photos from guests in the tavern’s Google listing.

A meze evening at Kyra Giorgena

Kyra Giorgena is a family tavern in a residential street of Larnaca, with blue and white tablecloths, wooden chairs and a courtyard. Most guests order the meze, and on Google they write that the dishes keep coming: dips, bread, vegetables, grill and sweets, one reviewer counted 28 plates. They describe the food as homemade and authentic, praise the warm welcome and the live Greek and Cypriot music, and many advise to come hungry.

Open Tuesday to Sunday from 19:00 to 22:30, closed on Mondays. Table reservations by phone.

What guests say

Four of 405 Google reviews, 4.6 stars on average.
